==================
interpolation: simple expression
==================

fn main() {
    let name = "world"
    print("hello {name}")
}

---

(source_file
  (function_declaration
    name: (identifier)
    parameters: (parameter_list)

          (binding_pattern
            name: (identifier)))
        value: (string
          (string_content)))

        expression: (call_expression
          function: (identifier)
          arguments: (arguments
            (argument
              value: (string
                (string_content)
                (interpolation
                  value: (identifier)))))))
      (rbrace))))

==================
interpolation: nested arithmetic
==================

fn main() {
    let a = 1
    let b = 2
    let c = 3
    print("{a + b * c}")
}

---

      (rbrace))))

==================
interpolation: map literal and index
==================

fn main() {
    print("{{"a": 1}["a"]}")
}

---

                      (rbrace))

                      (string_content)))))))))
      (rbrace))))

==================
interpolation: nested string
==================

    let x = 1
    print("{fn() => "inner {x}"}")
}

==================
interpolation: escaped braces and unicode escape

    print("literal \{ brace \} and \u{1F600}")
}

==================
interpolation: empty interpolation is an error
==================

fn main() {
    print("{}")
}

    print("{1 + }")
}

==================
interpolation: unterminated string recovers to the next statement
==================

    let text = "abc
    print("done")
}
